Products - AICORE Platforms & Software

Browse AICORE's portfolio of platforms and products across AI, automation, IoT, SaaS, and smart energy systems.

AICORE GrowthOS: AI-powered CRM and lead intelligence platform. Sales teams lose leads, miss follow-ups, and have no visibility into their pipeline performance.

Throughport WMS: Smart warehouse management system for traceability and inventory control. Warehouses lose stock, misplace inventory, and have zero visibility into throughput and movements.

IoT Monitoring Platform: Reusable sensor-to-cloud data collection and monitoring system. Organizations have deployed sensors and devices with no easy way to collect, visualize, or act on the data they generate.

Device Fleet Management: Remote management and OTA updates for connected device fleets. Companies with dozens or hundreds of deployed devices have no central way to monitor health, push updates, or diagnose failures remotely.

Smart Energy Monitoring: Performance tracking for solar arrays, batteries, and energy assets. Energy operators have limited visibility into how their solar panels, inverters, batteries, and transformers are performing in real time.

AI Business Assistant: Conversational AI assistant for business operations and decisions. Business teams spend hours searching through documents, reports, and systems to find answers they need immediately.

Are AICORE products ready-made or customisable? Some products are client-ready, while others are MVPs, prototypes, or internal platforms. AICORE can customise products around your workflows, data, users, integrations, and operational requirements.

Can we request a live demo before starting? Yes. For client-ready products, AICORE can walk you through the current product experience and discuss how it maps to your use case.

Do product pages show live screenshots? Some visuals are concept previews or sample screens. Product status is labelled clearly so you know whether a product is client-ready, MVP, prototype, or internal-use.

Can AICORE build a custom platform if no product fits? Yes. If an existing product is not a fit, AICORE can design and build a custom SaaS, automation, IoT, AI, or operations platform for your organisation.
